quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, Lohen? Is that... a report you're writing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a surprise. Paimon always figured you'd hate paperwork even more than Varka does.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Not at all. This is simply part of a captain's responsibility... even if I'm only the Vice Captain for now.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: This report concerns the personnel arrangements for the expeditionary force upon their return. It still needs to be reviewed by Cardinal Seamus, who was in charge of administration during the expedition.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: By the way, if you happen to be heading back to Mondstadt, would you mind taking this with you?

response.speaker: Lohen
response.text: Haha, that's precisely why I want to entrust it to you, Honorary Knight.

choices.text: But isn't this file a bit too important for me to just... carry back?

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Knight. What brings you to the Cathedral today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lohen asked me to drop off a report...

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Lohen? Submitting a report before the deadline? Truly a marvel of our time... Let me take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Hmm... The handwriting is quite neat, and the phrasing is very precise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong? Or is the report satisfactory?

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Nothing's wrong, aside from the fact that it's obvious Lohen didn't write a word of it. Ten to one, he outsourced this to Gunther or Ursula.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: Still, at least he turned it in on time for once, and it looks like he actually bothered to check it himself... I won't say any more.

dialogues.speaker: Seamus Pegg
dialogues.text: I only hope Grand Master Varka and Lord Barbatos can find it in their hearts to excuse him, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Knowing them... They'll let it slide.
